out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the customer women’s restroom and front area handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CORRECTED. Towels were provided during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the hand washing sink located at the dish washing area, is leaking at the bottom when operated.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair this sink and make it available for hand washing.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated.

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the cook-line handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw meat observed stored above potatoes and other vegetables and ready-to-eat foods, inside the stalk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: A VARIETY OF COOKED FOODS WITHOUT DATE TO SHOW OPOREP DATE OR USE-BUY-DATES, WERE NOTED IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The only available food temperature measuring device(THERMOMETER) was found broken and not working.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. PROVIDE A GOOD WORKING FOOD THERMOMETER.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: SEVERAL CONTAINERS OF food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label. FLOUR, SUGAR, SALTS, OR OTHER SPICES WERE NOT LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the kitchen and in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.
